title: Weekly SMS reminders from your debtors data table
summary: Every week, text each customer in your debtors data table who still has a balance, with no spreadsheet.
description: Once a week at the day and time you choose, reads your debtors from a data table in Taskiem (columns: name, phone, balance_kobo) and sends each customer with a balance above zero a polite SMS reminder with the amount and how to pay. Customers with nothing owed or no phone number are skipped. At most five messages go out at a time. Make the table under Tables first, or let Taskiem make it when you accept the workflow; no Google Sheet is needed.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: How your customers know you; it starts every message.

params.name: table
params.title: Debtors table
params.description: The name of the data table with name, phone and balance_kobo columns.

params.name: day
params.title: Day
params.description: The day of the week the reminders go out.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: The time the reminders go out, Lagos time.

params.name: payment_details
params.title: How to pay
params.description: Added to each reminder, e.g. your account number and bank.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

definition.name: Weekly SMS reminders from the debtors table
definition.description: Texts every customer in the debtors data table who still has a balance.

steps.name: Use your business name and payment details
Read the customers who still owe from the data table
Text the customer a reminder of what they owe
steps.when: =has(item.phone) && item.phone != null && has(item.balance_kobo) && item.balance_kobo != null && double(item.balance_kobo) > 0.0

input.sms: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': Hello ' + (has(item.name) && item.name != null ? string(item.name) : 'there') + ', a friendly reminder that NGN ' + string(double(item.balance_kobo) / 100.0) + ' is still outstanding. ' + steps.settings.output.payment_details
